answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a pearl forming layer by layer around a grain of sand: the deposit is returned only after honest work, and slashed for fraud. A sybil farm must then pay per fake identity, so creating thousands of clones costs more than they can earn. Verification adds another shale-like layer of checks, and each fake account faces a steep ledge of cost before it can act; honest agents climb it once, attackers must climb it a thousand times.
